findings.obligation: Pass workflow inputs to scripts via env, not by interpolation into the run line (injection hygiene)
findings.observation: Line 62 reads: run: bash tools/codesign/sign-windows.sh "${{ inputs.version }}". Non-blocking, severity low: the value is interpolated into shell source. Counterexample: a caller passing version '1"; id #' would run id; callers are internal today, and the old step interpolated it too. Pre-existing pattern.
findings.remediation: Add VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }} to the step env and call bash tools/codesign/sign-windows.sh "$VERSION" (owner implementation; may be left for a later change).
